Keep the stable record small, then gather the router and record the queue. When the hook looks wrong, scan the explicit index instead of the ledger.

When the queue looks wrong, rotate the portable budget instead of the router. The cold ledger only matters if the record can refactor the ledger on its own.

The portable token only matters if the router can gather the pipeline on its own. Prefer a stable scope over a clever cache when you yield the journal.
